moved.release-pipeline: .github/workflows/build.yml (one workflow for APK, desktop and web bundle; replaces release.yml, see notes)
moved.updaters: src/app/updater.ts, electron/main.cjs, electron/updater.cjs, electron/debInstall.cjs (vanilla variant: engine modules/updaters/variants/vanilla-electron), electron/preload.cjs
moved.logos: branding/logo.json, scripts/gen-icons.mjs, scripts/logo/, generated: public/icon*.svg|png, build/icon.png, android mipmaps and drawables

notes: TurboCut is a vanilla TypeScript app (no React, no Tailwind), so the engine's React files are followed as conventions, not copied: hook classes, tab recipe, dialog structure, panel cards, asset naming, version scheme, docs layout, guides inside Settings. Differences on purpose: (1) builds also run for claude/** branches and publish pre-releases, because the owner tests every branch on a phone; (2) no auto-pr.yml, the owner does not want pull requests unless asked; (3) check.yml is ci.yml and runs on every push; (4) turbothemes is installed from turboengine#path:/themes (the lockfile resolves it to a codeload tarball); (5) editions, window-frame, settings-shell and android-shell are not used: TurboCut has one edition, a native-looking window, and a plain Capacitor Android shell.
